title: Achievement tracks (three permanent milestones each, no reward)

goalScalePercent.description: Goal multiplier in percent per map size, applied to tracks with scalesWithMapSize (integer math, rounded down, at least 1).

achievements.description: Tracks in panel order. Milestone ids are '{id}.bronze', '{id}.silver', '{id}.gold' (stored in saves).

kind.description: achievementsUnlocked = percentage of the other milestones unlocked (at most one track; goals 1-100); lifetimeIncome = delivery income plus contract bonuses; contractsCompleted; vehicleTypesUnlocked = paid model unlocks; roadVehicleCount / trainCount = owned at the same time (wagons excluded); roadTilesTravelled / railTilesTravelled; largestTown = largest town population; cargoSold = units of one cargo delivered and paid to any destination.

labelKey.description: Localization key of the track label (ADR 0011). Required for every kind except cargoSold, which shows the cargo name.

cargo.description: Cargo ID. Required for cargoSold only; must exist in cargo.json.

scalesWithMapSize.description: Whether goalScalePercent applies to this track's goals (not allowed for achievementsUnlocked).

milestones.description: Bronze, silver, and gold, with strictly increasing goals.

goal.description: Positive threshold in the unit of the kind (a percentage for achievementsUnlocked), before map-size scaling.

nameKey.description: Localization key of the milestone title.
